in_sanskrit.name: वीरशान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses the quality of a hero or a valiant warrior.

in_hindi.name: वीरशान
in_hindi.long_meaning: वीर (valiant, heroic) + शान (reputation, honor), hence, a name meaning 'Having a reputation of a valiant hero.'

in_tamil.name: வீரசன
in_tamil.long_meaning: வீர (valiant, heroic) + சன (established, firm), hence, a name meaning 'Established as a valiant hero.'

in_telugu.name: వీరశాన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: వీర (valiant, heroic) + శాన (reputation, honor), hence, a name meaning 'Having a reputation of a valiant hero.'

in_marathi.name: Veerashan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Valiant, Brave Warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Veerashan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Veerashan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'veera', meaning 'hero' or 'brave'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the epitome of courage and strength. The name is often given to boys as a symbol of bravery and valor.
